ignorePatterns._comment: Relative links resolved from a .agents/skills/*/SKILL.md file to repo-root paths (../../data, ../../docs) are mis-resolved by the checker to a 400; they are validated as real files by validate-docs instead.

_comment_alive: Bot-blocked gov/standards hosts (congress.gov, gao.gov, media.defense.gov, iso.org) return 403 to the CI user-agent but are live in a browser; treat 403 as alive so real dead links still fail.
